description: This file defines the CachingStream class, a decorator for stream objects that adds caching capabilities to optimize read operations on sequential streams in the GuzzleHttp PSR-7 library.

classes.name: CachingStream
classes.description: A final class implementing StreamInterface that wraps another stream to provide caching of previously read bytes, allowing for efficient multiple reads and seeking within the stream.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the CachingStream with a source stream and an optional target stream for cached data.

methods.name: getSize
methods.description: Returns the size of the combined stream or null if unknown.

methods.name: rewind
methods.description: Resets the stream position to the beginning.

methods.name: seek
methods.description: Seeks to a specified offset within the stream, handling different seek modes.

methods.name: read
methods.description: Reads a specified number of bytes from the stream, utilizing cache and remote stream as needed.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Writes data to the stream and adjusts internal buffer to handle overwriting.

methods.name: eof
methods.description: Checks if the end of both the buffer and remote stream has been reached.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes both the remote and buffer streams.

methods.name: cacheEntireStream
methods.description: Caches the entire remote stream into the target stream.
